header: A morning on the sampling boat
lead: A 12-minute film with the field team on the lower Anbach. It shows how a sediment core is taken, labelled and logged before it reaches the laboratory.
caption: Recorded on the September 2025 sediment run between Reidau and the confluence.
note: Subtitles in German and English. The transcript is in the downloads below.
